mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domains ( id, tenant_id, application_id, hostname, scope, status, trust_class ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{applicationId}, #{hostname}, #{scope}, #{status}, #{trustClass} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, application_id, hostname, scope, status, trust_class, created_at, updated_at FROM domains WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT d.id, d.tenant_id, d.application_id, d.hostname, d.scope, d.status, d.trust_class, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM domains d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( (d.scope = 'APPLICATION_DEDICATED' AND d.application_id = #{applicationId}) OR ( d.scope = 'TENANT_SHARED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_domain_authorizations a WHERE a.application_id = #{applicationId} AND a.domain_id = d.id ) ) ) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC
SELECT id, tenant_id, application_id, hostname, scope, status, trust_class, created_at, updated_at FROM domains ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
